description: This file implements email sending functionality for Mattermost, including SMTP configuration, authentication, connection handling, and email composition with support for embedded files and headers.

classes.name: SMTPConfig
classes.description: Configuration settings for SMTP server connection and email sending options.

classes.name: mailData
classes.description: Data structure representing email message details, including recipients, subject, body, headers, and embedded files.

classes.name: smtpClient
classes.description: Interface representing an SMTP client with methods for mail transaction steps.

classes.name: authChooser
classes.description: Custom SMTP authentication handler that chooses between different auth methods.

classes.name: loginAuth
classes.description: Implementation of SMTP LOGIN authentication method.

methods.name: encodeRFC2047Word
methods.description: Encodes a string using RFC 2047 MIME encoding for email headers.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Method for authChooser to start SMTP authentication, selecting PLAIN or LOGIN.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Method for loginAuth to initiate LOGIN authentication, verifying server TLS and hostname.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Method for loginAuth to handle server challenges during LOGIN authentication.

methods.name: ConnectToSMTPServerAdvanced
methods.description: Establishes a TCP connection to SMTP server with optional TLS security based on configuration.

methods.name: ConnectToSMTPServer
methods.description: Wrapper to connect to SMTP server, calls advanced connection method.

methods.name: NewSMTPClientAdvanced
methods.description: Creates a new SMTP client with optional STARTTLS and authentication.

methods.name: NewSMTPClient
methods.description: Wrapper to create SMTP client, calls advanced method.

methods.name: TestConnection
methods.description: Tests SMTP server connectivity and authentication.

methods.name: SendMailWithEmbeddedFilesUsingConfig
methods.description: Sends an email with embedded files using specified SMTP configuration.

methods.name: SendMailUsingConfig
methods.description: Sends an email without embedded files using specified SMTP configuration.

methods.name: sendMailUsingConfigAdvanced
methods.description: Performs the actual email sending process with SMTP client and message data.

methods.name: sendMail
methods.description: Constructs and transmits the email message via SMTP client, including headers, body, and embedded files.
